name: Email Converter
helpText: Builds the org.ikasan.component.endpoint.email.producer.EmailPayload required by the Email Producer. The downstream component fed by this one should be an Email Producer, which sends the EmailPayload (email body plus any attachments) this converter builds.
allowableProperties_comment: Note that the order of properties in this file dictates the order displayed on screen, unless propertyDisplayOrder is set, which will be used as the primary key

componentName.helpText: The name of the component as displayed on diagrams. The name should be unique for the flow. The name will be used internally to reflect the bean created.

fromType.helpText: The type of data coming into this converter from the previous component in the flow, e.g. java.lang.Object or java.lang.String - enter just the plain class name. If the upstream component's own Output: text ends with an annotation like '(auto-converted)', that's an explanatory note, not part of the type - do not paste it in here.
fromType.validationMessage: Provide a fully qualified Java class name to be used as the type for the input to the converter.

requiresStub.helpText: Does this component require a stub to be generated by Studio, if not, it is assumed the user will provide the instance from its own factory class.

userImplementedClassName.helpText: The name of the class that will build the EmailPayload, the IDE will create a template for this class, the user must fill in the email body/attachment logic.
userImplementedClassName.validationMessage: Provide a valid java classname for the converter e.g. starting with upper case, followed by number/characters etc.

configuration.helpText: Provide the bean type that contains bespoke configurations for this component.
configuration.validationMessage: Provide a java classname for the Configuration bean.

configurationId.helpText: By default, the configuration ID = modulename + flowname + componentName + componentType. There are times when you may wish to override this i.e. if you want multiple flows to share the same configration or you have changed a flow name but don't want to update properties that may have already been stored in the override properties database.
